description: Reverse-ETL sink: write upstream DataFrame rows into Ramp -- create a mileage reimbursement, upload a receipt (optionally OCR'd into a draft reimbursement), issue a virtual card via Ramp's Vault API (production requires Ramp's approval review; works in Sandbox for all customers), or update a physical card's display_name/fund_id/automatic_routing_enabled (Ramp's API has no spend-limit-update endpoint for any card type).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream Dagster asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source:`.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`. Shapes: {kind: sql, resource_key/database_url_env_var, query}, {kind: csv, path, read_csv_kwargs}, {kind: inline, rows}.

reimbursee_id_column.label: Reimbursee Id Column
reimbursee_id_column.description: Upstream column holding the Ramp user ID of the reimbursement recipient. Required for mileage_reimbursement and receipt_reimbursement.

trip_date_column.label: Trip Date Column
trip_date_column.description: Upstream column holding the trip date (ISO date string). Required for mileage_reimbursement.

distance_column.label: Distance Column
distance_column.description: Upstream column holding the mileage distance. Required for mileage_reimbursement.

distance_units.label: Distance Units
distance_units.description: 'MILES' or 'KILOMETERS' -- applies to every row in mileage_reimbursement mode.

start_location_column.label: Start Location Column
start_location_column.description: Upstream column holding the trip start location (mileage_reimbursement).

end_location_column.label: End Location Column
end_location_column.description: Upstream column holding the trip end location (mileage_reimbursement).

memo_column.label: Memo Column
memo_column.description: Upstream column holding a free-text memo (mileage_reimbursement).

spend_allocation_id_column.label: Spend Allocation Id Column
spend_allocation_id_column.description: Upstream column holding a Ramp spend_allocation_id (mileage_reimbursement).

waypoints_column.label: Waypoints Column
waypoints_column.description: Upstream column holding a comma-separated list of waypoint addresses (mileage_reimbursement).

receipt_file_path_column.label: Receipt File Path Column
receipt_file_path_column.description: Upstream column holding a local filesystem path to the receipt image/PDF. Required for receipt_reimbursement.

reimbursement_id_column.label: Reimbursement Id Column
reimbursement_id_column.description: Upstream column holding an existing Ramp reimbursement_id to attach the receipt to. If omitted/blank for a row, Ramp attempts to auto-create a draft reimbursement via OCR on the receipt image (receipt_reimbursement).

idempotency_key_column.label: Idempotency Key Column
idempotency_key_column.description: Upstream column holding an idempotency key for the receipt upload. If unset, a deterministic key is derived per row from (reimbursee_id, receipt_file_path, reimbursement_id) so re-running the same row is idempotent (receipt_reimbursement).

user_id_column.label: User Id Column
user_id_column.description: Upstream column holding the Ramp user_id (cardholder). Required for virtual_card_create.

limit_amount_column.label: Limit Amount Column
limit_amount_column.description: Upstream column holding the spend limit amount. Required for virtual_card_create.

interval.label: Interval
interval.description: Spend limit interval, one of ANNUAL/DAILY/MONTHLY/QUARTERLY/TERTIARY/TOTAL/WEEKLY/YEARLY. Applies to every row. Required for virtual_card_create.

currency_code.label: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Currency code for the spend limit (virtual_card_create).

display_name_column.label: Display Name Column
display_name_column.description: Upstream column holding a display name. Used by both virtual_card_create (new card) and card_update (rename existing card).

spend_program_id_column.label: Spend Program Id Column
spend_program_id_column.description: Upstream column holding a Ramp spend_program_id (virtual_card_create).

transaction_amount_limit_column.label: Transaction Amount Limit Column
transaction_amount_limit_column.description: Upstream column holding a per-transaction amount limit (virtual_card_create).

lock_date_column.label: Lock Date Column
lock_date_column.description: Upstream column holding an ISO lock_date for the spend limit (virtual_card_create).

spending_restrictions_extra.label: Spending Restrictions Extra
spending_restrictions_extra.description: Static (same for every row) extra spending_restrictions fields to merge in, e.g. {'allowed_categories': [...], 'blocked_vendors': [...]} (virtual_card_create).

card_id_column.label: Card Id Column
card_id_column.description: Upstream column holding the Ramp card_id to update. Required for card_update.

fund_id_column.label: Fund Id Column
fund_id_column.description: Upstream column holding a new fund_id to attach to the card (card_update).

automatic_routing_enabled_column.label: Automatic Routing Enabled Column
automatic_routing_enabled_column.description: Upstream column holding a boolean for automatic_routing_enabled (card_update).

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: Ramp Reimbursement Card Write
